errors.evidence: This is an over-generalization for the light blue line representing 'Jugendliche und junge Erwachsene'. The line visibly fluctuates between 2011 and 2015, dropping from ~7.35 in 2011 to ~7.2 in 2014 before rising again.

The description states that the light blue line drops to 6.8 in 2021. According to the chart, the value in 2021 is approximately 6.6, where all three lines converge at their minimum. The value of 6.8 for the light blue line is reached in 2022, not 2021.
